request: Redo the TV-unit visual render so it follows the approved Jaipur Home living-room layout, geometry and design specifications rather than a generic TV-wall composition.
proposal: Draft a revised visual that replaces only the TV feature with a concealed-shutter composition. It must retain the actual large W5 window to the left, a 75-inch TV on the stair-enclosure wall, the current 9.22 ft / 2,810 mm low-console envelope, 10 ft model ceiling, and the compact perpendicular puja to the right. The unit is a shallow overlay to the existing wall; it does not fill the window bay or turn the puja into part of the TV joinery.
risks_and_dependencies: Current modelled TV-backing clearance to W5 is 61 mm; shutter casing and handles must remain out of this reveal.
The 2,810 mm console envelope and TV dimensions are modelled coordination intent, not final site fabrication dimensions.
Shutter swing, bracket fixing, cable routes, equipment ventilation and the junction to the puja need a measured shop drawing.
validation_plan: Check that the visual includes W5 left of the TV unit and the perpendicular puja to the right as separate elements.
Check 75-inch TV scale, ceiling-height context, continuous low console and concealed service intent.
Obtain independent visual QA before presenting the draft; no promotion requested.

results: The visual preserves the W5-window -> TV feature -> separate perpendicular puja -> kitchen sequence from the approved living layout.
It is suitable as a layout-specific concept visual only; exact TV, console, ceiling and W5-clearance dimensions cannot be certified from the perspective render.
Resolve the shutter faces behind the TV, independent masonry bracket backing, W5 swing clearance, ventilation free area and service access in a measured shop drawing.

open_next_actions: Preserve as withdrawn draft history; do not use for design or fabrication.
